g.text: ST-P public core / all dimensions between designated faces / south instances mirror z / no slab across flights
For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
6 × 6 envelope / 1.50 clear flights / 200 mm outer shell
Section follows both flights; no vertical exaggeration.
Each flight: 10 risers × 150 mm = 1.500 m rise; 9 treads × 280 mm = 2.520 m run.
The tenth rise terminates at a landing. Do not add a tenth independent tread and
then another riser at the landing.
LOCAL RECTANGLE / X, Z, W, D
Guard flight voids at 1.20, handrail 1.00 above nosing line. Rail
material must not reduce the specified clear width. Full-level
landing connects to the external apron; no closed balustrade across
Repeat at 3 m. Remove core volume from broad gallery floors and use
this explicit slab opening/landing. Build no flight above the
highest served level. Cap the top core at FFL +2.80; reserve 2.40
